correctness.rationale: Under the explicit replacement rule in Assumptions (one deletion and one insertion, not symmetric difference of size one), induced matchings are cliques in the complement of the squared line graph. The fresh standard-library replay at /workspace/branches/pappus_independent_replay.py enumerated its maximal cliques by pivoted Bron–Kerbosch and their faces, then built exchange neighbors in shared-face buckets. It reproduced maximum size 5, orders 135 and 27, zero top exchanges, unique parents and K5 fibers, 486 size-four exchanges, degrees 4:27 and 8:108, 54 quotient edges of multiplicity four, and the stated isomorphism on all 351 quotient pairs. All 135 BFS runs reached 135 states; eccentricities 8:108 and 9:27 and distances (486,648,918,1296,1836,2160,1242,432,27) reproduced exactly. With unique parents, cross-fiber adjacency requires parent overlap at least three and equality follows because overlap four is excluded; a common triple gives precisely the Cartesian product of two possible fourth edges on each side. Neither frozen program was executed.
residual_risks: Exhaustive verification is specific to the stated labeled LCF graph; no general reconfiguration theorem is inferred.
